body.name: EMT
body.def: \(\textsc{Explicit-Max-Tail}\) takes the binary encoding of \(a\), a rational \(\delta\), every labeled rational observed coordinate in \(y^{\mathrm{obs},\delta}\), the explicitly listed \(\Omega\), every rational weight \(w_z\), and rational \(q\), and asks whether some \(b\in\mathcal C_\delta(a)\) satisfies \(p(a,b)\ge q\)
